# meraki_blink_device_leds (Action)

This action can invoke the `Blink Device Leds` operation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "meraki_blink_device_leds" "example" {
  config {
    serial   = "1234-ABCD-1234"
    duration = 30
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (Number) The duration in seconds to blink LEDs.
- `serial` (String) Device serial
